Name: (SDR) - Ali's Mountain Farm
Author: klatuprism
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1095]Ali's Mountain Farm[/url] re-packaged as an expansion map for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10512]Stardew Realty[/url].  Ali's Mountain Farm converted to a Stardew Realty farm expansion for purchase.


The land is available on Day 1 of Year 2 for 500 gold.

You can customize the availability by editing the expansion.json file.  The file is located in the this mods top directory.  Open the expansion.json file in your favouriite text editor and modify the "Requirements" entry.  Blanking it out will make the land available at the start of the game.  You can also change the cost of the land by modifying the "Cost" entry.

Downloads.Description: Update for 1.6. Requires  latest Stardew Realty.
